title: AI and Holistic Review: Informing Human Reading in College Admissions
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not create a formal benchmark, but performed a data audit on college application essays. In relation to religion, it measured the statistical correlation of religious identity terms (specifically, the word 'jewish') with demographic characteristics (household income).
findings: The paper notes that historically, holistic review was introduced in part as a mechanism to legitimize the exclusion of Jewish applicants from elite universities. In its own empirical analysis of application essays, the word 'jewish' was found to be one of the top 10 most indicative words for applicants from above-median household income backgrounds, appearing 6.8 times more frequently in essays from this group compared to the below-median income group.
